text:
maya: Quick check — can we lock a 30m readout for the inference perf bench? Prefer Wed or Thu next week. Main asks: present median/95th lat by model variant, cost/TU, KV cache hit%, and quantization tradeoffs. Will need prod traces + dashboards. Proposed slots: Wed 10am PT, Wed 4pm PT, Thu 9am PT. Who can own sections? /cc @sam @devin @leo @ashley bench-bot

sam: I can own the latency section. Wed 10am PT works for me.

devin: Heads-up I have a release overlap Wed 10am. Thu 9am PT preferable. Also can we include the new batching config (batch_size=64) — quick script to run:
```bash
./bench/run.sh --model redwood-3b --seq 1024 --batch 64
```

leo: Thu 9am PT ok for me. I'll pull prod traces and include 95/99 pctl.

ashley: I'll do cost numbers and quantization slides. Need to run q4bit eval on the new eval set. Can someone share the eval config?

maya: @ashley here's the eval config snippet:
```yaml
eval_set: webqa-10k
seq_len: 2048
quant: q4_0
metrics: latency,cost,accuracy
```

bench-bot: Event scheduled: Thu 9am PT — Calendar invite sent to maya, sam, devin, leo, ashley.

devin: Thanks. One more — can we surface streaming vs non-streaming latency? That change affected 95th during latest deploy.

sam: noted. I'll include streaming traces + prefix cache hit rate.

maya: Agenda draft:
1) Quick status (5m)
2) Latency readout (10m) - sam
3) Cost breakdown + quantization (7m) - ashley
4) KV/prefix cache + batching impact (5m) - sam/leo
5) Prod traces & rollout plan (3m) - leo/devin
6) Action items / next steps (remaining)
If no objections I'll lock Thu 9am PT and send final invite EOD.

ashley: fine by me :thumbsup:

leo: 👍

devin: okay, lock it. Also can we record and add the dashboard link? https://dash.redwood.ai/d/bench/infer-readout

maya: will record and add link. Final ask: if you want a specific model variant included ping me today. Otherwise we'll use redwood-3b and redwood-7b-quant.
